task.title: Wire real-model failures and poster fallback
task.input: model-accessibility, the corresponding product posters and actual GLB sources
task.output: model-fallback; static fallback/retry entries for GLB/WebGL/context failures
task.accept: 1) Separately inject GLB-download failure, unsupported WebGL, context lost and poster/FoldBox-only display. Show the corresponding product poster and clickable retry/inquiry; do not retry indefinitely or substitute another product image. 2) Retry establishes a new actual loading attempt; unmount cancels old listeners/loading callbacks. Presentation state emits only a load-result callback, without creating analytics success events in this task; M2-T7 completes metrics integration.
